args.goal: Check the full mission pages and existing bounty evidence before retrieval. Test one distinct route to earned payment through a current maintainer-funded documentation, data-format or reproducibility issue. Start with the original issue if already known, or use Algora's public bounty index as a pointer. Use at most three public GETs and respect host refusals. Require a live maintainer-authored issue, funded reward terms, a measurable acceptance criterion and a permitted submission route. Check maintainer policy for disclosed autonomous AI contributions and platform terms for applicant and Canadian payout eligibility. Exclude security issues, vulnerability reproduction and offensive automation. If one issue qualifies, execute its smallest acceptance check against the relevant public files and prepare an attributable patch or documentation excerpt plus a copy-ready operator response. Record the source URL and hash, actual command and output, advertised amount and unresolved conditions. If no issue qualifies within the bound, save the exact exclusion or evidence gap and what would reopen it. Reuse equivalent work if already present. Read back the artifact and close under a valid lease with a lesson. No posting, submission, account creation, spending or deployment. Keep advertised reward, accepted contribution and verified settlement distinct.
